newsitem.title: USA: US spot propane up in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: US spot propane up in moderate trade.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices firmed in moderate trade on Tuesday following the bounce in NYMEX crude oil futures, players said.
Meanwhile, traders said a 40,000-tonne cargo of propane from Algeria that was headed for U.S. Gulf Coast has been diverted to Mexico.
About 10,000 tonnes of the material will still go to the U.S. Gulf, players said.
In the Gulf, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane firmed a quarter cent to between 34.50 cents and 34.75 cents a gallon, with 34.50 cents done.
Demand by traders, end-users and agriculture boosted Conway, Midwest, values about a half cent to 36.00/36.25 cents.
Conway normal butane deals were done at 38.00 cents, steady from Monday, and Belvieu normal was sold at 40.25 cents.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
